finding: Does recognizing steering reduce content uptake while preserving technique? With a correctly mapped signature, the constructed full-library reader changes its content belief by 0.0167 on average versus 0.1606 for the missing-process reader, while technique-production probability is 89.94% versus 89.46%. But the content gap persists without the signature, so the proposed vanishing-gap control fails. This supports a qualified library-and-signature mechanism, not a clean signature-only explanation.
